title.zh: Solana nearly froze as a single routing error took 29% of the network stake offline
title.en: Solana nearly froze as a single routing error took 29% of the network stake offline

current_state.zh: A Teraswitch routing failure knocked validators representing nearly 29% of Solana's stake offline on Aug. 12, degrading throughput and delaying finality for about half an hour while the chain continued producing blocks.
current_state.en: A Teraswitch routing failure knocked validators representing nearly 29% of Solana's stake offline on Aug. 12, degrading throughput and delaying finality for about half an hour while the chain continued producing blocks.
